+91 9111393391 bhawikavadhva@gmail.com linkedin.com/in/bhawikavadhva26
Oct 2021 – Oct 2024
Udaipur
May 2026
2018 - 2021
2018
2016
SUMMARY

Chartered Accountant with over three years of experience in Financial Analysis, Audit, and Financial Reporting across Hospitality,
Real Estate, Construction, Petroleum, Marble, Education, and Public Sector organizations. Skilled in P&L Analysis, Variance
Analysis, Working Capital Analysis, Financial Statement Analysis, and Management Reporting to support strategic decision-
making.
WORK EXPERIENCE

Article Trainee

Satyam SVG & Co.

	Performed Financial Statement Analysis for 15+ clients across Hospitality, Real Estate, Construction, Petroleum, Marble, and
Education sectors by analyzing P&L Statements, Balance Sheets, and supporting schedules to identify Revenue Trends, Cost
Drivers, Profitability, and Financial Risks.

	Evaluated the Business Performance of organizations with annual turnover ranging from ₹50–400 crore through analysis of
Revenue, Operating Expenses, Working Capital, and Capital Expenditure, delivering actionable Financial Insights to
management.

	Conducted Variance Analysis and assessed Liquidity, Profitability, and Working Capital, identifying key financial trends to
support Business Decision-Making and strategic discussions.

	Reviewed internal financial processes, strengthened Internal Controls, improved Reporting Accuracy, and recommended
Process Improvements to enhance operational efficiency and support reliable financial reporting.

	Executed Statutory, Bank, Tax, and Government Audits, developing expertise in Financial Reporting, Risk Assessment,
Compliance, and Financial Reconciliations.

	Prepared and reviewed Financial Reports, reconciliations, and supporting schedules while collaborating with Partners, Senior
Management, and Cross-functional Teams to communicate financial observations and recommend business-focused solutions.

	Collaborated with Partners, Senior Management, and Cross-functional Teams to communicate financial observations, resolve
accounting issues, and recommend Business-Oriented Solutions.


CERTIFICATIONS & SPECIALIZED TRAINING

Financial Modelling & Valuation | CA Monk
	Built integrated Three-Statement Financial Models incorporating Income Statement, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow
Forecasting.

	Performed Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Valuation, Trading Comparable Analysis, and Transaction Comparable Analysis to
evaluate Business Performance and Enterprise Value.

	Developed Financial Forecasts, Scenario Analysis, and Valuation Models.

	Conducted Industry Research, Peer Benchmarking, and Financial Analysis to support valuation assumptions.


Marketplace Business Simulation | Virtual Corporate Strategy
	Ranked among the Top 10% Globally in a six-quarter simulation involving Budgeting, Pricing Strategy, Demand Planning,
Production Planning, Investment Decisions, and Profitability Management.

	Prepared Cash Flow Forecasts, Budgets, ROI Analysis, and financial projections to optimize profitability while maintaining
liquidity.

	Evaluated Business Performance using Financial KPIs, Profitability Analysis, and Scenario-Based Decision Making.


EDUCATION

Chartered Accountant

The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India

Score: 52%

(Exemption in AFM)
Bachelor of Commerce

DAVV

Score: 71%

12th

CBSE

Score: 93%

(District Topper)
10th

CBSE

Score: GPA 9.0

SKILLS

Tools : Power BI, Advanced Excel (Pivot Tables, Macros, VBA), Tally, AI Tools for Finance

Financial Skills: Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Financial Statement Analysis, Budgeting & Forecasting, Financial Modelling &
Valuation, Business Performance Analysis


tel:+91 9111393391
mailto:bhawikavadhva@gmail.com
https://www.linkedin.com/in/bhawikavadhva26
